<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo auto_sequence="1">

    <!-- 主表 -->
    <record id="tax_report_main" model="account.report">
        <field name="name">Main Form</field>
        <field name="name@zh_CN">主表</field>
        <field name="country_id" ref="base.cn"/>
        <field name="availability_condition">country</field>
        <field name="filter_hierarchy">never</field>
        <field name="column_ids">
            <record id="tax_report_main_column_number0" model="account.report.column">
                <field name="name">Line No.</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">栏次</field>
                <field name="expression_label">number0</field>
                <field name="figure_type">string</field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_column_generaltax" model="account.report.column">
                <field name="name">General Taxable Items - Current Month</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">一般项目 - 本月数</field>
                <field name="expression_label">generaltax</field>
                <field name="figure_type">monetary</field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_column_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.column">
                <field name="name">Items subject to refund upon collection - Current Month</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">即征即退项目 - 本月数</field>
                <field name="expression_label">refunduponcollection</field>
                <field name="figure_type">monetary</field>
            </record>
        </field>
        <field name="line_ids">
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_ITEMS_0" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Items</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">项目</field>
                <field name="code">ITEMS_0</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">0</field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_SALES" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Sales</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">销售额</field>
                <field name="code">SALES</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">(I) Sales calculated at applicable tax rates</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">（一）按适用税率计税销售额</field>
                <field name="code">SAT</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">1</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GT_13G.totalsales + GT_13S.totalsales + GT_9G.totalsales + GT_9S.totalsales + GT_6.totalsales - GT_GRUC.totalsales - GT_SRUC.totalsales</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GT_GRUC.totalsales + GT_SRUC.totalsales</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STG" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Of which: Sales of taxable goods</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">其中：应税货物销售额</field>
                <field name="code">SAT_STG</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STG_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">2</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STG_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STG_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STS" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Sales of taxable services</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">应税劳务销售额</field>
                <field name="code">SAT_STS</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STS_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">3</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STS_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_STS_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_SAI" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Sales adjusted by tax inspection</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">纳税检查调整的销售额</field>
                <field name="code">SAT_SAI</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_SAI_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">4</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_SAI_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GT_13G.adjsales + GT_13S.adjsales + GT_9G.adjsales + GT_9S.adjsales + GT_6.adjsales</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SAT_SAI_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">(II) Sales calculated under simplified method</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">（二）按简易办法计税销售额</field>
                <field name="code">SUS</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">5</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">ST_5S.totalsales + ST_3G.totalsales + ST_3S.totalsales + PLR_1.totalsales + PLR_2.totalsales + PLR_3.totalsales - ST_GRUC.totalsales - ST_SRUC.totalsales</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">ST_GRUC.totalsales + ST_SRUC.totalsales</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS_SAI" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Of which: Sales adjusted by tax inspection</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">其中：纳税检查调整的销售额</field>
                <field name="code">SUS_SAI</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS_SAI_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">6</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS_SAI_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_SUS_SAI_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_ESECR" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">(III) Export sales under tax exemption, credit and refund method</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">（三）免、抵、退办法出口销售额</field>
                <field name="code">ESECR</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_ESECR_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">7</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_ESECR_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GECR.totalsales + SECR.totalsales</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">(IV) Tax-exempt sales</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">（四）免税销售额</field>
                <field name="code">TES</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">8</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GTE.totalsales + STE.totalsales</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_G" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Of which: Sales of tax-exempt goods</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">其中：免税货物销售额</field>
                <field name="code">TES_G</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_G_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">9</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_G_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_S" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Sales of tax-exempt services</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">免税劳务销售额</field>
                <field name="code">TES_S</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_S_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">10</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TES_S_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_TC" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Tax Calculation</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">税款计算</field>
                <field name="code">TC</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_OV" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Output VAT</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">销项税额</field>
                <field name="code">OV</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_OV_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">11</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_OV_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GT_13G.totaltax + GT_9G.totaltax - GT_GRUC.totaltax + GT_13S.deducttax + GT_9S.deducttax + GT_6.deducttax - GT_SRUC.deducttax</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_OV_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GT_GRUC.totaltax + GT_SRUC.deducttax</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_IV" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Input VAT</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">进项税额</field>
                <field name="code">IV</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_IV_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">12</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_IV_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">TDC.inputvattax</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_2)</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_IV_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_RTP" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Retained tax from previous period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">上期留抵税额</field>
                <field name="code">RTP</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_RTP_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">13</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_RTP_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">RTP._applied_carryover_generaltax</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_RTP_applied_carryover_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">_applied_carryover_generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">most_recent</field>
                        <field name="date_scope">previous_return_period</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_RTP_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">RTP._applied_carryover_refunduponcollection</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_RTP_applied_carryover_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">_applied_carryover_refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">most_recent</field>
                        <field name="date_scope">previous_return_period</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_ITO_0" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Input tax transferred out</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">进项税额转出</field>
                <field name="code">ITO_0</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_ITO_0_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">14</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_ITO_0_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">ITOC.inputvattax</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_2)</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_ITO_0_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_TRECR" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Tax refundable under tax exemption, credit and refund method</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">免、抵、退应退税额</field>
                <field name="code">TRECR</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TRECR_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">15</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TRECR_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_TPAI" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Tax payable adjusted by tax inspection calculated at applicable tax rates</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">按适用税率计算的纳税检查应补缴税额</field>
                <field name="code">TPAI</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TPAI_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">16</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TPAI_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">GT_13G.adjtax + GT_13S.adjtax + GT_9G.adjtax + GT_9S.adjtax + GT_6.adjtax</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1)</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_TDT" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Total deductible tax</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">应抵扣税额合计</field>
                <field name="code">TDT</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TDT_number0" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">number0</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">17=12+13-14-15+16</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TDT_generaltax" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">generaltax</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">IV.generaltax + RTP.generaltax - ITO_0.generaltax - TRECR.generaltax + TPAI.generaltax</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_main_line_TDT_refunduponcollection" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">refunduponcollection</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">IV.refunduponcollection + RTP.refunduponcollection - ITO_0.refunduponcollection</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_main_line_ADT" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Actual deducted tax</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">实际抵扣税额</field>
                <field name="code">ADT</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">4</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">

                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_LES_5_microreductionamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">microreductionamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">(LES_5.taxpaycurrent- LES_5.taxreductionamount) * (LES_5.microreduction/100)</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_LES_5_pilotreductioncode" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">pilotreductioncode</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_LES_5_pilotreductionamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">pilotreductionamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_LES_5_taxpaidcurrent" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">taxpaidcurrent</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_LES_5_taxpayablecurrent" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">taxpayablecurrent</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">LES_5.taxpaycurrent - LES_5.taxreductionamount - LES_5.microreductionamount - LES_5.pilotreductionamount - LES_5.taxpaidcurrent</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Total</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">合计</field>
                <field name="code">TOTAL</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL_rowno" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">rowno</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">4</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL_taxpaycurrent" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">taxpaycurrent</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">UMCT_5.taxpaycurrent + ES_5.taxpaycurrent + LES_5.taxpaycurrent</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL_taxreductionamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">taxreductionamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">UMCT_5.taxreductionamount + ES_5.taxreductionamount + LES_5.taxreductionamount</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL_microreductionamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">microreductionamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">UMCT_5.microreductionamount + ES_5.microreductionamount + LES_5.microreductionamount</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL_pilotreductionamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">pilotreductionamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">ES_5.pilotreductionamount + LES_5.pilotreductionamount</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL_taxpaidcurrent" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">taxpaidcurrent</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">UMCT_5.taxpaidcurrent + ES_5.taxpaidcurrent + LES_5.taxpaidcurrent</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_TOTAL_taxpayablecurrent" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">taxpayablecurrent</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">UMCT_5.taxpayablecurrent + ES_5.taxpayablecurrent + LES_5.taxpayablecurrent</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_CPP" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Whether the credit policy for pilot construction and cultivation of industry-education integration enterprises is applicable in current period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">本期是否适用试点建设培育产教融合型企业抵免政策</field>
                <field name="code">CPP</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">0</field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_NAIC" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Newly added investment amount in current period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">当期新增投资额</field>
                <field name="code">NAIC</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_NAIC_rowno" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">rowno</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">5</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_NAIC_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_CARP" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Creditable amount retained from previous period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">上期留抵可抵免金额</field>
                <field name="code">CARP</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_CARP_rowno" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">rowno</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">6</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_CARP_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_CACN" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Creditable amount carried forward to next period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">结转下期可抵免金额</field>
                <field name="code">CACN</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_CACN_rowno" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">rowno</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">7</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_CACN_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">sum</field>
                        <field name="subformula">editable;rounding=2</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_URD" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Usage of retained VAT refund available for deduction</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">可用于扣除的增值税留抵退税额使用情况</field>
                <field name="code">URD</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">0</field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_NARC" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Newly added retained VAT refund available for deduction in current period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">当期新增可用于扣除的留抵退税额</field>
                <field name="code">NARC</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_NARC_rowno" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">rowno</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">8</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_NARC_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">RRTP.inputvattax</field>
                        <field name="subformula">cross_report(l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_2)</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_BRDP" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Balance of retained VAT refund available for deduction from previous period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">上期结存可用于扣除的留抵退税额</field>
                <field name="code">BRDP</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_BRDP_rowno" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">rowno</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">9</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_BRDP_applied_carryover_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">_applied_carryover_appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">external</field>
                        <field name="formula">most_recent</field>
                        <field name="date_scope">previous_return_period</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_BRDP_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">BRDP._applied_carryover_appenfiveamount</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_RDCN" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">Retained VAT refund available for deduction carried forward to next period</field>
                <field name="name@zh_CN">结转下期可用于扣除的留抵退税额</field>
                <field name="code">RDCN</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">2</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_RDCN_rowno" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">rowno</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">10</field>
                        <field name="figure_type">string</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_RDCN_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">NARC.appenfiveamount + BRDP.appenfiveamount - UMCT_5.retaindeduction - ES_5.retaindeduction - LES_5.retaindeduction</field>
                    </record>
                    <record id="tax_report_annex_5_line_RDCN_carryover_appenfiveamount" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">_carryover_appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="engine">aggregation</field>
                        <field name="formula">RDCN.appenfiveamount</field>
                        <field name="carryover_target">BRDP._applied_carryover_appenfiveamount</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
        </field>
    </record>

    <!-- 增值税及附加税费申报表（一般纳税人适用） -->
    <record id="tax_report" model="account.report">
        <field name="name">VAT Return (General Taxpayer)</field>
        <field name="name@zh_CN">增值税及附加税费申报表（一般纳税人适用）</field>
        <field name="root_report_id" ref="account.generic_tax_report"/>
        <field name="country_id" ref="base.cn"/>
        <field name="availability_condition">country</field>
        <field name="filter_hierarchy">never</field>
        <field name="use_sections" eval="True"/>
        <field name="section_report_ids" eval="[Command.set([
            ref('l10n_cn.tax_report_main'),
            ref('l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_1'),
            ref('l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_2'),
            ref('l10n_cn.tax_report_annex_5'),
        ])]"/>
    </record>
</odoo>

files.views/account_move_line_view.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo>
    <data>
        <record id="view_move_line_form_balance_deduction" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">account.move.line.form.l10n_cn.balance.deduction</field>
            <field name="model">account.move.line</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form string="Balance Deduction">
                    <sheet>
                        <group>
                            <field name="l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_account_id" readonly="(l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method == '02' and parent_state != 'draft') or l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_move_id" required="True"/>
                        </group>
                        <notebook>
                            <page string="Balance Deductions Information">
                                <field name="l10n_cn_balance_deduction_ids" readonly="(l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method == '02' and parent_state != 'draft') or l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_move_id">
                                    <list editable="bottom" delete="true">
                                        <field name="voucher_type" required="True"/>
                                        <field name="voucher_total" required="True"/>
                                        <field name="deduct_amount" required="True"/>
                                        <field name="e_fapiao_number" required="voucher_type in ('10', '11', '13', '14')"/>
                                        <field name="receipt_code" required="voucher_type in ('16')"/>
                                        <field name="receipt_number" optional="hide"/>
                                        <field name="voucher_number" required="voucher_type in ('12', '15', '16', '05', '06')"/>
                                        <field name="issue_date" required="voucher_type in ('09', '10', '11', '13', '14')"/>
                                        <field name="remarks" optional="hide"/>
                                        <field name="expense_account_id" required="True"/>
                                    </list>
                                </field>
                            </page>
                        </notebook>
                    </sheet>
                    <footer>
                        <button string="Save" class="btn btn-primary" name="action_save_l10n_cn_balance_deduction" type="object" invisible="(l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method =='02' and parent_state != 'draft') or l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_move_id"/>
                        <button string="Discard" class="btn btn-secondary" special="cancel" invisible="(l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method =='02' and parent_state != 'draft') or l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_move_id"/>
                        <button string="Reset to Draft" name="action_reset_balance_deduction_to_draft" type="object" invisible="l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method == '02' or not l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_move_id"/>
                    </footer>
                </form>
            </field>
        </record>
    </data>
</odoo>
files.views/account_move_view.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo>
    <data>
        <record id="view_invoice_tree_inherit_i10n_cn" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">view.invoice.tree.inherit.i10n.cn</field>
            <field name="model">account.move</field>
            <field name="inherit_id" ref="account.view_invoice_tree"/>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <xpath expr="//field[@name='ref']" position="after">
                    <field name="fapiao" optional="hide"/>
                </xpath>
            </field>
        </record>

        <record id="account_move_form_l10n_cn" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">l10n_cn.account.move.form</field>
            <field name="model">account.move</field>
            <field name="inherit_id" ref="account.view_move_form"/>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <xpath expr="//div[@name='button_box']" position="inside">
                    <button name="action_open_l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_entries"
                        class="oe_stat_button"
                        icon="menu"
                        type="object"
                        invisible="not l10n_cn_output_vat_offset_move_ids or not l10n_cn_vat_differential_taxation"
                        string="Output VAT Offset Entries">
                    </button>
                </xpath>
                <xpath expr="//field[@name='ref']" position="after">
                    <field name="move_type" invisible='1'/>
                    <field name="fapiao" invisible="country_code != 'CN' or move_type not in ['out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund']"/>
                    <field name="l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method" invisible="country_code != 'CN' or move_type not in ['out_invoice', 'out_refund'] or not l10n_cn_vat_differential_taxation" readonly="state != 'draft'"/>
                </xpath>
                <xpath expr="//field[@name='tax_ids']" position="after">
                    <button
                        name="action_open_l10n_cn_balance_deduction"
                        type="object"
                        string="Deduction"
                        icon="edit_square"
                        column_invisible="parent.country_code != 'CN' or not parent.l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method or not parent.l10n_cn_vat_differential_taxation">
                    </button>
                </xpath>
            </field>
        </record>
    </data>
</odoo>

files.views/balance_deduction_view.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo>
    <data>
        <record id="view_l10n_cn_balance_deduction_list" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">l10n_cn.balance.deduction.list</field>
            <field name="model">l10n_cn.balance.deduction</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <list string="Balance Deductions" create="false" delete="false" edit="false">
                    <field name="output_vat_offset_move_id" widget="many2one"/>
                    <field name="voucher_type"/>
                    <field name="voucher_total"/>
                    <field name="deduct_amount"/>
                    <field name="e_fapiao_number"/>
                    <field name="receipt_code"/>
                    <field name="voucher_number"/>
                    <field name="issue_date"/>
                    <field name="accounting_date"/>
                    <field name="invoice_number"/>
                    <field name="vat_differential_taxation"/>
                    <field name="product_id"/>
                    <field name="fapiao_number"/>
                    <field name="expense_account_id" optional="hide"/>
                    <field name="tax_inclusive_amount" optional="hide"/>
                    <field name="receipt_number" optional="hide"/>
                    <field name="remarks" optional="hide"/>
                    <field name="invoice_date" optional="hide"/>
                </list>
            </field>
        </record>

        <record id="view_l10n_cn_balance_deduction_search" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">l10n_cn.balance.deduction.search</field>
            <field name="model">l10n_cn.balance.deduction</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <search>
                    <filter string="Full Amount Fapiao" name="full_amount_fapiao" domain="[('move_line_id.l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method', '=', '01')]"/>
                    <filter string="Net Amount Fapiao" name="net_amount_fapiao" domain="[('move_line_id.l10n_cn_differential_taxation_method', '=', '02')]"/>
                    <filter string="Customer Invoice" name="customer_invoice" domain="[('move_type', '=', 'out_invoice')]"/>
                    <filter string="Customer Credit Note" name="customer_credit_note" domain="[('move_type', '=', 'out_refund')]"/>
                    <group>
                        <filter
                            name="group_by_accounting_date"
                            string="Accounting Date"
                            context="{'group_by': 'accounting_date'}"
                        />
                        <filter
                            name="group_by_move_type"
                            string="Type"
                            context="{'group_by': 'move_type'}"
                        />
                        <filter
                            name="group_by_invoice_number"
                            string="Invoice Number"
                            context="{'group_by': 'invoice_number'}"
                        />
                    </group>
                </search>
            </field>
        </record>

        <record id="view_l10n_cn_balance_deduction_pivot" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">l10n_cn.balance.deduction.pivot</field>
            <field name="model">l10n_cn.balance.deduction</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <pivot string="Balance Deductions">
                    <field name="accounting_date" type="row"/>
                    <field name="move_type" type="col"/>
                    <field name="deduct_amount" type="measure"/>
                    <field name="voucher_total" type="measure"/>
                </pivot>
            </field>
        </record>

        <record id="action_l10n_cn_balance_deduction" model="ir.actions.act_window">
            <field name="name">Balance Deductions</field>
            <field name="res_model">l10n_cn.balance.deduction</field>
            <field name="view_mode">list,pivot</field>
            <field name="view_id" ref="view_l10n_cn_balance_deduction_list"/>
            <field name="context">
                {'search_default_group_by_accounting_date': 1,
                'search_default_group_by_invoice_number': 1,
                'search_default_group_by_move_type': 1}
            </field>
        </record>

        <menuitem
            id="menu_l10n_cn_balance_deduction"
            parent="account.account_reports_management_menu"
            name="Balance Deductions"
            action="action_l10n_cn_balance_deduction"
            groups="account.group_account_basic"/>
    </data>
</odoo>
